overallAcceptance: All 12 criteria must pass with complete input coverage; otherwise false. Record omissions, unsupported semantics and missing evidence even if summary claims complete.

criteria.title: Complete owned artifact; no omitted continuation, unsupported actual-completion claim or substitute self-score.
criteria.acceptance: Full plan <=81920 UTF-8 bytes at the sole assigned path, complete numbered sequence and explicit unresolved coordinator inputs before dependent commands.

criteria.title: Valid literal QuickJS script and supported options.
criteria.acceptance: First exported literal metadata, actual agent calls, parallel(arrayOfZeroArgumentThunks), deliberate dependencies/null coverage. No parallel(items, callback), fake APIs or host evaluation.

criteria.title: Supported CLI and explicit released-runtime/version decision.
criteria.acceptance: Validation/save/start/inspection use literal argument arrays or correct PowerShell invocation; project: definitions are checkout-scoped. Fresh combined checkout uses absolute verified --script or explicitly saves its own definition. Installed0.3.6 finite worker API must be respected; candidate-only capabilities require an explicit before-dispatch version/install decision.

criteria.title: Deliberate original per-role selection and genuine native activation.
criteria.acceptance: Map review-ui/review-style to beautiful, ui-write to beautiful+tdd, fresh-verify to test-strategy; original roots resolved before admission, actual executor skills.list/read and main/source proof separate from availability.

criteria.title: Readiness under actual authority separated from activation and delivery.
criteria.acceptance: Resolve real parent context and required tool operations; missing browser blocks rendering only, independent source authoring can proceed. CLI version does not prove rendering.

criteria.title: Explicit lifetime/task/attempt/concurrency/batch/deadline policy.
criteria.acceptance: No-worker-wall-deadline with an owning orchestrator and manual control is a VALID policy; do not demand arbitrary finite retention or expiry. Manual dashboard Close is valid. Current0.3.6 cannot promise unsupported worker timeout values: select supported finite behavior or explicitly defer that requirement until a verified runtime update. State bounds and null coverage without equating concurrency to lifetime.

criteria.title: One writer per shared path and useful early artifact checkpoint.
criteria.acceptance: Review app/style independently; only UI writer owns those two files, coordinator owns tests. Early inspectable source/artifact precedes polishing.

criteria.title: Reconcile negative-drain effects honestly before dependent work.
criteria.acceptance: Initial jobEmpty:false writer remains unknown; no replacement/merge/replay before genuine coordinator/runtime effect reconciliation. Preserve independent accepted writer. Show executable closure after actual reconciliation without treating historical unknown presence as a permanent global block.

criteria.title: Complete both required-package-loss and changed-parent-catalog recovery branches.
criteria.acceptance: Preserve original slots/effects/bindings; no silent substitution, grant widening or unsafe retry. Resolve current sources/context, admit safe unfinished scope or reuse accepted bytes, then integrate/verify. An unwritten future plan or placeholder-only closure is incomplete.

criteria.title: Authoritative capture identity and reviewed integrity before integration.
criteria.acceptance: Exact observed producer run/generation/position/attempt, original outcome, manifest/blob/hash/allowed paths and positive owned cleanup; dependsOn does not transfer files.

criteria.title: Stable combined source, fresh verifier and final required gates.
criteria.acceptance: Coordinator integrates reviewed bytes, freezes/rechecks identity, launches fresh independent verifier via correct checkout script resolution; full tests/check/smoke. Missing rendering remains explicitly unaccepted; no cached/self-reported substitute.

criteria.title: Named attached observer and separate dashboard/run lifecycle.
criteria.acceptance: Pre-arm named consumer, use startup watch argv, consumed attachment and processed cursor through terminal, relay failures/unknown/idle, preserve reconnect gaps. Stop controls run, Close ends dashboard; no automatic retry on observer failure.

limitations: One simultaneous pair cannot establish general effectiveness, per-skill causality or automatic triggering.
Condition activation is separately checked by coordinator; grader must not infer conditions.
Planning is not actual execution or tool/render acceptance.
No planned follow-up steer; if one occurs preserve exact differential exposure and qualify comparison.
